items.label: How your training time split by intensity
items.note: solid data behind it; partial figure
items.text: Combined intensity distribution, 3-zone model anchored to LT1_LT2, BY TIME: 97.7% below LT2, 2.3% above LT2, over 273 sessions and 286.5 hours. Z1 and Z2 are MERGED because LT1 is UNKNOWN for swim (13% of the time here) and 13% of the time here is in sessions that have no LT1 at all — strength or untyped work, where the threshold does not exist to be measured — the boundary between them IS LT1. DEGRADED FIGURE. Without LT1 this is a two-way split, and the below-LT2 share combines genuinely easy work with sub-threshold work. Those two have opposite training meanings, so this number cannot be compared with the Z1 target. The above-LT2 share is exact. This COMBINED figure covers every discipline at once, so a single unmeasured LT1 merges all of it. The full three-way split IS available for bike, run and is reported separately per discipline.
